mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% indicates a tightening labor market, which typically boosts corporate profit growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls below 5.0%, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust aggregate demand, leading to higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in RSAFS and HOUST fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of rising industrial production (INDPRO > 105.0), supply chain improvements reduce input costs and boost corporate margins, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO exceeds 105.0, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the Consumer Price Index above 0.5% signals accelerating inflation, prompting anticipated Federal Reserve tightening and negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in the last month
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5% in a month, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High consumer spending levels (RSAFS > 400,000) indicate strong household demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS exceeds 400,000, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1,100,000 units signals a robust housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST exceeds 1,100,000, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO > 100) indicates expanding economic output, which supports corporate earnings growth and generates positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is above 100, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.
